ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "good morning (the reply)"? (1 mark)
   A. إِصْبَعٌ
   B. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   C. نَظِيفٌ
   D. صَبَاحُ النُّورِ

2. What does the Arabic word كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) mean? (1 mark)
   A. welcome
   B. How are you? (to a boy)
   C. I
   D. and upon you peace (the reply)

3. What does the Arabic word مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) mean? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. my name is
   C. How are you? (to a boy)
   D. hello

4. What does the Arabic word خَالَةٌ (khaala) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. son
   C. mother's brother
   D. mother's sister

5. The nuclear family is made of (1 mark)
   A. neighbours
   B. parents and their children
   C. uncles and aunts only
   D. grandparents and cousins

6. What does the word al- do at the start of an Arabic word? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'and'
   B. It means 'the'
   C. It means 'my'
   D. It means 'not'

7. What does the Arabic sentence الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. The lamp is above the table.
   C. The cat is under the bed.
   D. The pen is in the bag.

8. How is the Arabic word الْخَمِيسُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-khamiis
   B. as-sabt
   C. al-ahad
   D. amsi

9. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Thursday.
   B. There are seven days in a week.
   C. I go to school on Monday.
   D. I play on Saturday.

10. What does the Arabic word طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. birthday
   B. please, go ahead
   C. food
   D. friend

11. What does the Arabic sentence عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. May you be well every year.
   B. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   C. Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   D. Happy birthday.

12. What does the Arabic word رَقْصٌ (raqs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. please, go ahead
   B. dance
   C. no
   D. yes

13. Which is a good way of reducing food waste? (1 mark)
   A. Throw away leftovers
   B. Leave food outside uncovered
   C. Take only what you can eat
   D. Cook more than needed

14. Which Arabic sentence means "I eat bread." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ
   B. أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ
   C. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   D. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ

15. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ يَدِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my hand.
   B. I see with my eye.
   C. I smell with my nose.
   D. I hear with my ear.

16. What does the Arabic word قَلْبٌ (qalb) mean? (1 mark)
   A. face
   B. heart
   C. stomach
   D. finger

17. Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cloudy." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   B. الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ
   C. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   D. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ

18. Which sentence means 'I plant a tree'? (1 mark)
   A. laa narmii l-qumaama
   B. nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a
   C. al-maa'u nadhiif
   D. azraʿu shajara

19. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you for listening.
   B. I like my house.
   C. In my house there is a kitchen.
   D. I am in Grade 4.

20. Which is good body language for a speaker? (1 mark)
   A. Looking at the floor
   B. Turning your back
   C. Hiding behind the paper
   D. Standing straight and looking at the audience

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write four weather words in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Explain the difference between kayfa haaluka? and kayfa haaluki? (2 marks) (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: shukran li-istimaaʿikum (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis (2 marks)

25. Write three classroom instructions in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya (2 marks)

27. Explain why a speaker should practise before speaking to an audience. (2 marks) (2 marks)

28. Translate into English: al-jawwu baarid (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: haadhihi yadii (2 marks)

30. Name four key words about the home in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

31. Translate into English: alʿabu yawma s-sabt (2 marks)

32. Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — صَبَاحُ النُّورِ
   صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (sabaahu n-nuur) means good morning (the reply).

2. B — How are you? (to a boy)
   كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) means How are you? (to a boy).

3. A — goodbye
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

4. D — mother's sister
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

5. B — parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the smallest family group: parents and their children.

6. B — It means 'the'
   al- is the word for 'the', as in al-kitaab, the book.

7. A — The book is on the table.
   الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila) means: The book is on the table.

8. A — al-khamiis
   الْخَمِيسُ is read al-khamiis and means Thursday.

9. B — There are seven days in a week.
   فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ (fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam) means: There are seven days in a week.

10. C — food
   طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

11. D — Happy birthday.
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

12. B — dance
   رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

13. C — Take only what you can eat
   Taking only what you can eat and saving leftovers reduces waste.

14. D — آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

15. A — This is my hand.
   هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

16. B — heart
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

17. B — الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

18. D — azraʿu shajara
   azraʿu means I plant and shajara means tree.

19. D — I am in Grade 4.
   أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ (anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ) means: I am in Grade 4.

20. D — Standing straight and looking at the audience
   Eye contact and a steady stance help the audience to listen.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), matar (rain), riih (wind), sahaab (clouds).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: kayfa haaluka? is said to a boy or man. kayfa haaluki? is said to a girl or woman. Both mean 'How are you?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy and girl endings and 1 mark for the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you for listening.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example qif (stand up), ijlis (sit down), iftahi l-baab (open the door).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practice helps the speaker to remember words, pronounce them correctly and feel less nervous.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for remembering or pronouncing and 1 mark for confidence.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: I play on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.
